chenguang-kargilik-xinjiang.conditions_add: IFC's loan was a six-year senior secured loan in Chinese yuan, and IFC applied its Performance Standards on labour, pollution, community safety and Indigenous Peoples to it. Under the Environmental and Social Action Plan the company was required to appoint an environment, health and safety coordinator, set up a stakeholder grievance mechanism, commission an independent third-party safety audit of its cottonseed plant and bring neighbouring communities into its emergency plans (IFC, Environmental and Social Review Summary and Summary of Investment Information, project 40616).

why.repay: a six-year senior secured loan in Chinese yuan
why.safeguard: required to appoint an environment, health and safety coordinator, set up a stakeholder grievance mechanism, commission an independent third-party safety audit

portucel-mozambique-plantations.conditions_add: IFC applied its Performance Standards, including those on land acquisition and resettlement, biodiversity and labour, to its equity investment, and the agreed Environmental and Social Action Plan required Portucel Moçambique to obtain government approval of a full environmental and social impact assessment, follow a new land access procedure and document land acquisition for areas already planted and to be planted, and commission a third-party audit of its labour practices. IFC said it would complete its review after Board approval based on evidence of broad community support (IFC, Environmental and Social Review Summary, project 32522).

andhra-pradesh-community-forest.conditions_add: The 1994 project agreement for the first Andhra Pradesh Forestry Project (Credit 2573-IN) required the state to carry out an agreed Tribal Development Plan, run field investments under joint forest management plans with villagers, and raise seedling prices every year to cover full production costs. The 2002 project agreement for the Community Forest Management Project (Credit 3692-IN) required Andhra Pradesh to comply with its Resettlement Action Plan and Tribal Development Plan, including village-level plans, and to set up an Independent Advisory Group to examine complaints about resettlement (World Bank, Project Agreements, 1994 and 2002).

why.safeguard: required Andhra Pradesh to comply with its Resettlement Action Plan and Tribal Development Plan
why.prices: raise seedling prices every year to cover full production costs

colombo-st-sebastian-canal-mcudp.conditions_add: The 2012 loan agreement (Loan 8145-LK) required Sri Lanka to carry out the project in line with its safeguard instruments, including resettlement action plans prepared under the Social Management Framework, which had to be approved by the Bank and disclosed locally before any affected project work began; every civil works contract paid for by the loan had to oblige the contractor to apply those safeguard requirements (World Bank, Loan Agreement, 2012).

why.safeguard: approved by the Bank and disclosed locally before any affected project work began

saguling-dam.conditions_add: The 1981 Tenth Power Project loan (Loan 1950-IND) could take effect only once Indonesia signed a subsidiary agreement passing the money on to the power company PLN on the same terms, with the government bearing the exchange-rate risk. The project agreement required PLN to fund at least 30% of its capital spending from its own revenues from 1985/86, keep its debt-to-equity ratio at or below 60:40, and the government to pay its electricity bills by the 15th of each month (World Bank, President's Report P-2949-IND and Project Agreement, 1981). The Bank's report lists no resettlement covenant; it describes resettlement decrees already issued by local leaders.

why.repay: with the government bearing the exchange-rate risk

conakry-water-lease.conditions_add: The 1989 credit agreement for the Second Water Supply Project (Credit 1985-GUI) could take effect only after SEEG, the part-private operating company, had been set up with its first capital paid in and the lease contract signed; the credit could be suspended if the lease was changed without IDA's consent. It also required the government to close the old water agency DEG, including ending its staff contracts and selling its assets, by 31 December 1989, and to pay public bodies' water bills, allowing water to be cut off to any with arrears over four months. The project agreement required the state asset company SONEG to earn an annual return of at least 1.5% on its assets in 1991-93 and 2.5% after that (World Bank, Credit Agreement and Project Agreement, 1989); the President's report says water rates were to be adjusted regularly to reach these returns.

why.priv: could take effect only after SEEG, the part-private operating company, had been set up with its first capital paid in and the lease contract signed
why.prices: water rates were to be adjusted regularly to reach these returns

upper-krishna-almatti.conditions_add: The 1989 Upper Krishna II credit and loan (Credit 2010-IN, Loan 3050-IN) required Karnataka to carry out a detailed resettlement plan so that displaced people would regain or improve their standard of living, pay for annual independent monitoring of resettlement, build Almatti Dam only after demand forecasts showed the water could be used within three years, and recover full operation and maintenance costs from irrigation users by the fourth year (World Bank, Implementation Completion Report 18091, 1998). When resettlement lagged, the Bank suspended disbursements in November 1992 and set benchmarks for lifting the suspension, including land valuation, housing grants and completion of 25% of the resettlement programme (World Bank OED, Report 17542, 1998).

why.safeguard: required Karnataka to carry out a detailed resettlement plan so that displaced people would regain or improve their standard of living
why.fees: recover full operation and maintenance costs from irrigation users by the fourth year

eastern-dedicated-freight-corridor.conditions_add: The 2011 EDFC-I loan (Loan 8066-IN) required the Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation to carry out the project in line with its Resettlement Action Plan, Resettlement Policy Framework and environmental plans, to set up district grievance committees and an Ombudsman by 30 September 2011, and to review and update the resettlement plan each year with the Bank. The loan agreement also required India to have a Bank-approved resettlement action plan in place before civil works began on linked road overbridges in Uttar Pradesh, and to sign a concession agreement between the Railways Ministry and the corporation on terms satisfactory to the Bank (World Bank, Loan Agreement and Project Agreement, 2011).

why.safeguard: set up district grievance committees and an Ombudsman by 30 September 2011

xiaolangdi-resettlement.conditions_add: The 1994 IDA credit could take effect only together with the loan for the Xiaolangdi dam itself. At negotiations China agreed to carry out the Resettlement Plan to criteria set by IDA, time dam construction and reservoir filling with resettlement, hire an independent monitoring institution and an international panel of experts and carry out their agreed recommendations, and set up a Reservoir Area Support Fund to keep resettlers' and hosts' incomes up (World Bank, Staff Appraisal Report, 1994).

why.safeguard: time dam construction and reservoir filling with resettlement

upper-indravati-oustees.conditions_add: The 1983 credit and loan could take effect only after a consultants' report on project management was received; the project agreement required the Orissa power board to fund at least 20% of its investment from earnings, cut unpaid bills and reduce energy losses. On resettlement, the Bank only included an assurance in the project agreement requiring Orissa to draw up a resettlement plan at least two years before flooding and carry it out (World Bank, Staff Appraisal Report, 1983; Implementation Completion Report 15676, 1996).

why.safeguard: requiring Orissa to draw up a resettlement plan at least two years before flooding and carry it out

pantabangan-dam-resettlement.conditions_add: Before the 1969 loan was signed the government had to set up a special fund holding three months of local-currency costs, and it gave assurances that water rights would be transferred to the irrigation agency NIA and no private water rights harming the project would be granted (World Bank, Appraisal Report, 1969). The loan agreement set no figures for water charges but adopted a cost-recovery period of 'not less than 25 years' (World Bank OED, Report 3063, 1980).

benet-mount-elgon-2008.conditions_add: The 2002 project agreement for the IDA credit (Credit 3690-UG) barred the Uganda Wildlife Authority from carrying out any involuntary resettlement of people living inside the protected areas, or restricting their access in ways that harmed livelihoods, though it allowed the Authority to stop new encroachment (World Bank, Project Agreement, 2002). No terms were found for the FACE Foundation's money.
